description: Source code for gzip and related archive handling functions, including listing, extracting, and adding files with support for various compression types and features like password protection and special formats.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_check_lrzip
methods.description: Checks if lrzip supports password encryption by running the command with '-h' and searching for the '-e, --encrypt[=pass]' option.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_zstd_option
methods.description: Checks if a specific zstd option is present in the output string.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_check_zstd
methods.description: Finds the zstd compressor or decompressor in the system path and checks its capabilities, setting flags for list and test support.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_password_str
methods.description: Generates the command-line string for passing the password to the compressor, with special handling for lrzip.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_get_command
methods.description: Constructs the shell command to run the compressor with the specified parameters.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_compressor
methods.description: Returns the compressor settings based on the archive type.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_can
methods.description: Sets the capabilities flags of the archive object based on whether operations like test, extract, add, and compress are allowed.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_ask
methods.description: Enables all capabilities for the archive.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_parse_output
methods.description: Parses the output line from listing commands to extract file info, handling different archive types.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_parse_lrzip
methods.description: Parses the output of lrzip listing to extract file info.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_parse_zstd
methods.description: Parses the output of zstd listing to extract file info.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_prepared_items
methods.description: Prepares initial file info for listing, based on filename.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_list
methods.description: Lists contents of the archive, handling different formats and setting up parsing.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_test
methods.description: Runs a test command to verify archive integrity.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified files from the archive.

methods.name: xa_gzip_et_al_add
methods.description: Adds files to the archive, supporting compression, password, and special formats.
